comps.label: C3

comps.label: C4

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Truck-based finished-vehicle hauling for automakers; different mode and cargo from ocean dry bulk freight.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Railcar leasing and manufacturing; leases equipment rather than carrying cargo by ship, with a manufacturing component.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Less-than-truckload terminal network in North America and Europe; different mode and business from dry bulk ocean shipping.
